findings.highlight: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.
findings.evidenceJa: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
findings.governingReading: Stopping now could preserve meaningful selfhood for about one day although body is already beyond saving; next calls it one-day extension.
findings.explanation: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.

findings.highlight: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.
findings.evidenceJa: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
findings.governingReading: Internal crack specifically affects 大脳の側座核, followed by motivation/pleasure gloss.
findings.explanation: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.

findings.highlight: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.
findings.evidenceJa: 右手の指を食べる痛みも、記憶の消失を止められない。
findings.governingReading: Even pain from biting fingers of right hand cannot stop disappearing memory.
findings.explanation: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.
